Let \(T=K+Л+A\). Since the 10 distinct letters use all digits \(0\)–\(9\),

\[
(C+E+Д+b+M+O+И)+T=45.
\]

So the numerator sum is \(45-T\). The equation becomes

\[
\frac{45-T}{T+2C}=\frac{22}{23}.
\]

Thus

\[
23(45-T)=22(T+2C)
\]

\[
1035-23T=22T+44C
\]

\[
45T+44C=1035.
\]

Modulo \(45\),

\[
44C\equiv 0 \pmod{45}.
\]

Since \(\gcd(44,45)=1\), we get \(C\equiv 0\pmod{45}\). As \(C\) is a digit,

\[
C=0.
\]

This is feasible, e.g. \(T=23\) with \(K,Л,A=6,8,9\). Therefore the only possible value is

\[
\boxed{0}
\]
